tasha: Spot check: Rival 'NimbusAI' running a new claim - 'one API, instant on any hardware' in their latest ad. Need micro-copy for SDRs + one webinar slide.
mona: can you paste the claim or screenshot?
diego: pasted. main thrust: universal API + 'no infra expertise required'.
sam: quick framing: call out tradeoffs. universal API != optimal serving. infra shape and workload patterns change perf.
evan: SDR 1-liner ideas:
- For engineers: 'We optimize runtime kernels and caching to your model and traffic patterns for predictable tail latency.'
- For execs: 'Consistent latency and transparent unit costs across hosted, dedicated, or private deployments.'
mona: make those one short sentence each please.
diego: shortened: Engineer: 'Runtime tuned to your workload for lower tail latency.' Exec: 'Predictable latency & clear cost controls.'
sam: webinar bullets (3):
1) Serving-first optimization: kernels, batching, KV cache
2) Routing & fallbacks for reliability
3) Observability: token-level cost + latency breakdowns
tasha: ops question: can we say 'lower tail latency'? legal flagged earlier. keep it 'improved latency' maybe.
mona: good point. swap to 'improved latency' across assets.
evan: action items:
- @diego: drop two SDR one-liners (tech + exec) into Notion by 1pm PT
- @sam: draft 1-slide webinar frame with the 3 bullets + a 1-sentence note on why 'one API' claims gloss over infra tuning by EOD
- @mona: quick legal check on 'improved latency' copy and share blockers
ops-bot: Reminder set: Notion drop due 13:00 PT today (channel: #marketing).
tasha: thanks all  keep copy short and punchy.
